decisions.reason: Repeated gold-medal recognition in 2023 and 2024 signals performance above aspiration levels and strong external validation, so management would likely continue it.

Its continued dedicated presentation across 2023 and 2024 suggests satisfactory results in a core bread category, though without standout evidence it still faces some review risk if it only meets aspirations narrowly.

The product remained actively presented in both years, indicating acceptable performance, but as a seasonal variant beside a clearly award-winning stollen it is somewhat more exposed to portfolio pruning if resources are redirected.
